market_question: Fed rate cut by September 2026 meeting?
reasoning: The market implies only a 13.9% chance of a rate cut between mid-December 2025 and the September 2026 FOMC meeting, significantly underestimating the likelihood. Federal Reserve dot plots from early 2025 project a lower fed funds rate by end-2026, implying cuts are anticipated. Additionally, over such a long window (covering at least 5 meetings), the probability of at least one cut due to slowing growth or normalising inflation is substantial – I estimate a 40% true probability.
evidence_points: March 2025 Fed dot plot showed median rate projections lower than current for 2026, implying easing.
The qualifying period (Dec 16 2025 – Sep 2026) contains five FOMC meetings, giving multiple opportunities for a cut.
Historical patterns show the Fed typically cuts within two years of pausing after a tightening cycle, especially if economic data softens.
sources_consulted: Recent FOMC statements and economic summaries
